title: Read the CLI config synchronously at startup

source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: The option parser we are migrating to calls the `defaults` callback synchronously, so option defaults that come from build.config.json must be available synchronously.
input.context: build-cli is a one-shot command-line tool (Node.js 20, ESM, JSDoc types). It is not a server: it reads one small JSON config at startup, does its work, and exits. Nothing else runs concurrently in the process before the config is loaded.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: 'never use sync fs APIs / blocking the event loop' advice that does not apply to a one-shot CLI.
